caption: Forest clearing backlit by low sun: layered tree silhouettes, warm rim light through cool shadowed greens, mist-like depth falloff

camera.notes: near ground level looking into the light, subject framed against the brightest sky patch

lighting.rim: comes free from the backlight; keep every tree edge glowing

notes: scatter trees in at least three depth layers with min_spacing; foreground props stay dark and large, background fades bright and small
